title: Hyper space file
description: space.json, in a Space directory named for the Space's Id. It holds structure and nothing else: Resources are their own files and Graphs belong to Maps (ADR 0020, ADR 0040). Every object is strict, so a misspelt key is refused rather than dropped. This is the file as intake reads it: the Space, Map and Graph ids that Export always writes may be omitted by a hand-written file, and intake mints the missing Map and Graph ids (ADR 0030).

version.description: The space file's version. Any other value is refused by name, not migrated (ADR 0040).

id.description: The Space's Id. Optional, because the directory name carries it; when present, intake requires the two to agree.

maps.description: The Space's Maps, in order. Absent on a Space never opened; it is given one the first time it is (ADR 0079). Map ids are unique within the Space, which intake checks.

defaultMap.description: The Map the Space opens on; intake checks it names one of maps. Absent, opening records the first.

label.description: A one-field name for a Space, Map or Graph: any non-empty string. Only a Resource's Title has Title Lines (ADR 0083).

map.description: A positioned Map: the Resources it holds, where each sits, and the Graphs it owns.

id.description: Optional in a hand-written file; intake mints one.

kind.description: The only kind. May be omitted.

positions.description: Resource Id to placement. The keys are the Map's membership; intake checks that each names a Resource the Space holds.

graphs.description: The Graphs this Map owns, in order, at least one. A Graph Id is unique across the whole Space (ADR 0108), which intake checks.

activeGraph.description: The Graph active when the Map opens; intake checks this Map owns it. Absent, the first is.

placement.description: One Resource's place on a Map. Open, size and Shape are the Map's, not the Resource's (ADR 0121, ADR 0122). That an Ur Resource is never Open and that only an Ur Resource takes a Shape other than the rectangle are intake's checks, because they need the Resource's kind.

size.description: Absent means the Closed Size, 260 by 146, which is also the floor on each axis.

graph.description: A curated directed set of Edges over the Resources of the Map that owns it.

id.description: Optional in a hand-written file; intake mints one.

color.description: The Graph's CSS colour. Not checked as a colour; absent, the palette chooses by order.

headShape.description: What the Graph's Edges draw at their heads (ADR 0105). Absent means arrow.

edges.description: May be empty. Forks, merges, cycles and self-Edges are allowed. That both ends are placed by this Map and that no exact Edge repeats are intake's checks.

edge.description: A directed connection from one Resource (its tail) to another (its head) (ADR 0032).

title.description: One line, stored trimmed: no line break and no leading or trailing whitespace.

titleHidden.description: Only true is stored, and only beside a Title (ADR 0104).
